1.text: Akigenda abona umuntu wavutse ari impumyi.

2.text: Abigishwa baramubaza bati “Mwigisha, ni nde wakoze icyaha, ni uyu cyangwa ni ababyeyi be ko yavutse ari impumyi?”

3.text: Yesu arabasubiza ati “Uyu nta cyaha yakoze cyangwa ababyeyi be, ahubwo ni ukugira ngo imirimo y'Imana yerekanirwe muri we.

4.text: Nkwiriye gukora imirimo y'uwantumye hakiri ku manywa, bugiye kwira ni igihe umuntu atakibasha gukora.

5.text: Nkiri mu isi ndi umucyo w'isi.”

6.text: Amaze kuvuga atyo acira amacandwe hasi, ayatobesha akondo akamusīga ku maso,

7.text: aramubwira ati “Genda wiyuhagire mu kidendezi cy'i Silowamu”, (hasobanurwa ngo “Yaratumwe”). Nuko aragenda ariyuhagira, agaruka ahumutse.

8.text: Abaturanyi be n'abamubonaga kera ahora asabiriza barabazanya bati “Uyu si we wicaraga asabiriza?”

9.text: Bamwe bati “Ni we.”Abandi bati “Si we, icyakora asa na we.”Na we arabasubiza ati “Ni jye.”

11.text: Arabasubiza ati “Wa muntu witwa Yesu yatobye akondo, akansīga ku maso arambwira ati ‘Jya i Silowamu wiyuhagire.’ Nuko ndagenda ndiyuhagira, ndahumuka.”

14.text: Kandi ubwo hari ku munsi w'isabato, uwo Yesu yatobeyemo akondo akamuhumūra.

15.text: Nuko Abafarisayo na bo bongera kumubaza uko yahumutse. Arababwira ati “Yansīze akondo ku maso, ndiyuhagira ndahumuka.”

16.text: Bamwe mu Bafarisayo baravuga bati “Uwo muntu si uw'Imana kuko ataziririza isabato.”Abandi bati “Umunyabyaha yabasha ate gukora ibimenyetso bingana bityo?” Baramupfa.

17.text: Nuko bongera kubaza uwari impumyi bati “Ku bwawe umuvugaho iki ubwo yaguhumūye?”Ati “Ni umuhanuzi.”

18.text: Ariko Abayuda ntibemera yuko yari impumyi agahumuka, kugeza aho bamariye guhamagara ababyeyi b'uwahumutse.

19.text: Barababaza bati “Uyu ni umwana wanyu muvuga ko yavutse ari impumyi. None yahumuwe n'iki?”

20.text: Ababyeyi be barabasubiza bati “Tuzi yuko uyu ari umwana wacu, kandi yavutse ari impumyi.

21.text: None arareba ariko igituma areba ntitukizi, kandi n'uwamuhumūye ntitumuzi. Nimumwibarize namwe, ni umugabo mukuru arivugira.”

22.text: Icyatumye ababyeyi be bavuga batyo ni uko batinyaga Abayuda, kuko Abayuda bari bamaze guhuza inama, yuko umuntu wese uzerura Yesu ko ari Kristo acibwa mu isinagogi.

23.text: Ni cyo cyatumye ababyeyi be bavuga bati “Ni umugabo mukuru nimumwibarize.”

24.text: Nuko rero uwari impumyi bamuhamagara ubwa kabiri, baramubwira bati “Shima Imana, twebwe tuzi yuko uwo muntu ari umunyabyaha.”

25.text: Na we arabasubiza ati “Niba ari umunyabyaha simbizi, icyo nzi ni kimwe, ni uko nari impumyi none nkaba ndeba.”

27.text: Arabasubiza ati “Maze kubibabwira ntimwabyumva. Icyo mushakira kubyumva ubwa kabiri ni iki? Mbese namwe murashaka kuba abigishwa be?”

28.text: Baramutuka baramubwira bati “Ni wowe mwigishwa we, ariko twebweho turi abigishwa ba Mose.

29.text: Tuzi yuko Imana yavuganye na Mose, ariko uwo muntu ntituzi aho yaturutse.”

30.text: Arabasubiza ati “Iri ni ishyano, ko mutazi aho yaturutse kandi ari we wampumuye!

31.text: Tuzi yuko Imana itumva abanyabyaha, ariko uyubaha agakora ibyo ishaka, uwo ni we yumva.

32.text: Uhereye kera kose, ntihari haboneka umuntu wahumuye uwavutse ari impumyi.

33.text: Uwo muntu iyaba atavuye ku Mana, nta cyo yabashije gukora.”

34.text: Baramusubiza bati “Wowe wavukiye mu byaha bisa, ni wowe utwigisha?” Bamusunikira hanze.

35.text: Yesu yumvise yuko bamusunikiye hanze aramushaka, amubonye aramubaza ati “Mbese wizeye Umwana w'Imana?”

36.text: Na we aramusubiza ati “Databuja, ni nde nkamwizera?”

37.text: Yesu aramubwira ati “Wamubonye, kandi ni we muvugana.”

38.text: Na we aramubwira ati “Databuja, ndizeye.” Aramupfukamira.

39.text: Yesu aravuga ati “Nazanywe muri iyi si no guca amateka ngo abatabona barebe, n'ababona bahume.”

40.text: Abafarisayo bamwe bari kumwe na we bumvise ibyo baramubaza bati “Mbese natwe turi impumyi?”

41.text: Yesu arababwira ati “Iyo muba impumyi nta cyaha muba mufite, ariko none kuko muvuga yuko mureba, icyaha cyanyu gihoraho.”
